name: PB-02: Create a parent page with a child subpage and verify the hierarchy in the Pages tree

steps.name: Navigate directly to Page Builder list (/admin/landing-pages)
Create new Page Builder page: "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214"
Wait for visible: Page title input in modal
Fill "Page title" with "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214"
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Create page' })
Wait for Page Builder editor to load
Wait for visible: Back to Page Builder main button
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Back to Page Builder main' })
Switch to Pages tab in left panel
Assert page "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214" is visible in the Pages tree
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214' })
Add subpage "PB Child via thorax" under "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214"
Open page-level Actions menu for "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214"
Click: Actions menu button (page: "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214")
Wait for visible: Page-level Actions menu
Click 'Add subpage' in page Actions menu
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Add subpage' })
Fill subpage name: "PB Child via thorax"
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i })
Fill "Subpage page title" with "PB Child via thorax"
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i }).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Page title' })
Fill "PB Child via thorax" getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i }).getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Page title' })
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Create page' })
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Create page' })
Click getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Create page' })
Wait for hidden: Create subpage dialog (dismissed)
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: /Create new subpage/i })
Assert subpage "PB Child via thorax" is nested under "PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214" in the Pages tree
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'PB Parent terror labore 1779722403214' })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'PB Child via thorax' })
Click Save
